questions: Do you work or are you a student?

Where is your hometown?
What do people usually do for fun there?

part2.card: Describe a skill you learned that took a long time.
points: when and how you learned it
part2.explain: and explain how you feel about this skill now.
part3: Why do some people give up learning a skill before they master it?
Do you think schools should teach more practical skills? Which ones?
Is it easier for children or adults to learn new skills? Why?

part2.card: Describe a quiet place you like to visit.
part2.explain: and explain why you like this place.
part3: Why do many people find it hard to find quiet places in cities?
Should governments create more public spaces such as parks? Why?
How has technology changed the way people relax?

part2.card: Describe a person who has influenced the way you think.
part2.explain: and explain how they changed the way you think.
part3: Who usually has more influence on young people: parents or friends?
Do famous people have a responsibility to set a good example?
How can teachers inspire students who are not interested in learning?

part2.card: Describe an important decision you made.
part2.explain: and explain whether you think it was the right decision.
part3: What kinds of decisions do young people find hardest to make?
Should parents make important decisions for their children?
Do people make better decisions when they have more choices?

part2.card: Describe something you own that is very important to you.
points: how long you have had it
part2.explain: and explain why it is important to you.
part3: Why do some people keep old things for many years?
Do you think people today buy too many things they do not need?
How have advertisements changed what people want to own?

part2.explain: and explain why you enjoyed it.
part3: Are traditional celebrations becoming less important nowadays?

How do celebrations help to bring communities together?

part2.card: Describe a book or film that made you think differently.
points: when you read or watched it
part2.explain: and explain how it changed your view of something.
part3: Why are films based on books so popular?
Do you think people read fewer books than in the past? Why?

part2.card: Describe a journey that did not go as planned.
part2.explain: and explain how you dealt with the situation.
part3: Why do people enjoy travelling to unfamiliar places?
How has tourism changed popular destinations in your country?
Do you think people will travel more or less in the future?

part2.card: Describe a website or app you use often.
part2.explain: and explain why you find it useful.
part3: What are the risks of children using the internet without supervision?
Has the internet made people more or less sociable?
Should companies be allowed to collect information about their users?

part2.card: Describe a goal you would like to achieve in the next few years.

part2.explain: and explain how you will feel if you achieve it.
part3: Is it important for young people to set long-term goals?

part2.explain: and explain how you felt afterwards.
part3: Why do some people volunteer to help others without being paid?

part2.explain: and explain why you think it is important.
part3: Whose responsibility is it to protect the environment: individuals or governments?
